theorems.name: Submission.dea_ae_variationMeasure_ball_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ R Λ : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ closedBall x R ⊆ U ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R → variationMeasure V (closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * V.weight (closedBall x r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
